CustomField.formula:
IF( AND(ISBLANK(Shift_Start_Time__c), ISBLANK(Shift_End_Time__c)), Add_Shift__r.Shift_Start_End_Time__c,
IF(ISBLANK(Shift_Start_Time__c), "", IF(HOUR(Shift_Start_Time__c) = 0, "12", IF(HOUR(Shift_Start_Time__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Shift_Start_Time__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Shift_Start_Time__c)-12)) ) & ":" & IF(MINUTE(Shift_Start_Time__c) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(Shift_Start_Time__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Shift_Start_Time__c))) & IF(HOUR(Shift_Start_Time__c) < 12, " AM", " PM") ) & " - " & IF(ISBLANK(Shift_End_Time__c), "", IF(HOUR(Shift_End_Time__c) = 0, "12", IF(HOUR(Shift_End_Time__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Shift_End_Time__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Shift_End_Time__c)-12)) ) & ":" & IF(MINUTE(Shift_End_Time__c) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(Shift_End_Time__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Shift_End_Time__c))) & IF(HOUR(Shift_End_Time__c) < 12, " AM", " PM") ) )
CustomField.label: Shift Start End Time
